metadata.title: How natural of a geometric operation is Murasugi sum?
metadata.abstract: Gabai proved that any Murasugi sum of $\pi_1$-essential Seifert surfaces is also $\pi_1$-essential, and Ozawa extended this result to unoriented spanning surfaces. We show, however, that the analogous statement about geometrically essential surfaces is untrue. (A spanning surface is geometrically essential if it cannot be compressed or boundary compressed to another spanning surface.) We also ask when plumbing an unknotted annulus (with any number of twists) onto a compressible spanning surface yields a compressible surface. We provide positive and negative examples, and we establish a simple sufficient condition. As an application, we obtain a new constructive proof of a result of Hatcher and Thurston about essential spanning surfaces for 2-bridge knots and links.
metadata.comment: 32 pages, 34 figures. The first 19 pages of this paper were previously part of arXiv:2408.16948 . Comments welcome!

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 指出 Murasugi 和保持 π₁ 本质性的经典结果不能直接替换为几何本质性，并为给可压缩曲面接环带后的可压缩性提供正反例及充分条件。
analysis.breakthrough: 厘清两种本质性的差异，并给出 Hatcher–Thurston 相关结果的新构造证明。
analysis.limitations: 反例针对几何本质性，不能被解读为否定已有 π₁ 本质性定理；部分内容来自先前稿件。 本次依据官方公告摘要分析，尚未核查正文和完整证明；未见披露仅指当前已读摘要与作者评论。
analysis.priorityReason: 概念澄清与具体曲面操作结合，适合三维拓扑阅读组。
